title: Shelter expansion construction was underway on October 14, 2026
statement: Crossover observed construction activity during its October 14 visit to Stockton Animal Services.
limitations: Construction observed during one visit does not establish a completion date, delivered animal-care capacity, or operational impact.

title: Current street-dog population is not established
statement: The reviewed shelter intake figures do not establish the current number of free-roaming dogs in Stockton.
limitations: Shelter intake is a period flow over a multi-jurisdiction service area. A current Stockton street-population estimate requires an appropriate observation and estimation method.

title: Animal Services reports regular shelter capacity pressure
statement: Animal Services Manager Ashley Kluza reported that the Stockton shelter is at capacity regularly.
limitations: This is an attributed operating-condition report, not a measured occupancy series or a citywide count of dogs without care.

title: Healthy stray intake differs from urgent and abandonment response
statement: Stocktonia reports that healthy stray intake generally requires appointments, while sick, injured, aggressive, and confirmed abandonment cases receive priority for acceptance or investigation.
limitations: The report does not establish appointment wait times, field response rates, case outcomes, or whether every urgent animal received care.

title: Roaming does not establish that a dog is unowned
statement: Animal Services says roaming dogs can be owned dogs that escaped or were not contained. Lost, abandoned, and genuinely unowned dogs must be distinguished with case-level evidence.
limitations: Neither source classifies all dogs seen on Stockton streets or gives the current proportions of each category.

title: A temporary found-animal foster pathway has been publicly described
statement: Animal Services described a pathway for residents to temporarily foster found animals while intake or adoption is arranged.
limitations: Public description establishes neither current eligibility or capacity nor successful use, reunification, adoption, or other outcomes. Crossover has not tested the pathway.
